AC-2: ./ui2/gradlew -p ui2 clean assemble succeeds offline of any dynamic version resolution
AC-3: ./ui2/gradlew -p ui2 architectureTest --tests '*Ui2ArchitectureTest' passes with exactly ten test methods named for DIR-1..DIR-10, each asserting the forbidden edge named in section 2.1
AC-4: ./ui2/gradlew -p ui2 unitTest passes and starts no container

AC-5: npm --prefix ui2/frontend ci && npm --prefix ui2/frontend test && npm --prefix ui2/frontend run build succeed from the lockfile alone and emit static assets under the path the service module expects
AC-6: contract check 1 holds: no .python-version under ui2/ and no main.py/python/console/_runner.py/_collector.py reference in ui2 sources
AC-7: .github/workflows/validation.yml is byte-identical to its pre-movement version
AC-8: git diff --check clean; python3 scripts/repository_privacy_check.py reports no new finding

baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_0_B1_01_SKELETON_CI_DOCKER_CONTRACT.md (DRAFT -- FOR PRODUCT OWNER FREEZE, 2026-09-10) sections 2, 2.1, 3, 4 and 5 are the implementation authority for this slice. baseline.sequencing: Slice A of B1-1: everything validatable without a Docker daemon. Slice B (Testcontainers integration harness, Dockerfile, image inspection, CI job) follows as its own movement on a machine with Docker.

invariants: UI 2.0 is one Java runtime; nothing under ui2/ references Line-1 Python or its paths (DIR-10)

report.merge_gate: Two gates: (1) Product Owner freeze of the B1-1 contract; (2) PO review of diff and the Slice A validation results. No self-merge. Privacy gate at push; git diff --check.
report.objective: Create the ui2/ Gradle multi-module skeleton exactly as the B1-1 contract section 2 module map and section 2.1 direction rules specify: twelve Gradle subprojects with the named package roots and the exact allowed project dependencies, the Gradle wrapper, version/toolchain pinning and dependency locking per section 3.1, the unitTest/architectureTest task wiring per section 3.2, the ArchUnit Ui2ArchitectureTest with ten one-to-one DIR-1..DIR-10 test methods per section 5, and the frontend TypeScript workspace (npm, lockfile, a trivial passing test and a build that emits static assets). No Dockerfile, no Testcontainers integration tests, no CI workflow edit -- those are Slice B.
output_contract: The ui2/ tree exactly as contract sections 2-5 specify for this slice
Validation plan commands green in a foreground run, with real output quoted
SESSION_CLOSE on the relay with exact changed files, test results, the DEFERRED list for Slice B, blockers and commit state

recommended_reasoning.reason: Large but fully specified scaffold; the care point is ArchUnit rules that are genuinely enforcing rather than vacuous.

requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law
Read the contract sections 2, 2.1, 3, 4, 5 and 8 fully; read nothing else outside scope.in
Java 21 toolchain; no dynamic dependency versions; dependency locking enabled
Every module's package root and allowed dependency set matches the section 2 table exactly

risks: Inventing module names or dependencies instead of copying the section 2 table

Pulling a dynamic version or a plugin that resolves at build time
Adding a Dockerfile or a Testcontainers test that cannot run here
